Mental health action tip for the day… A GRATITUDE LIST. This changed my everyday being and gave me a new way to start each day. 

I learned this from an actual Thai monk in Ko Samui, Thailand. He asked me to write down 100 things I’m grateful for. At the time I was in a VERY VERY DARK PLACE. Absolutely self loathing, mired in depression and couldn’t see the light at the other side of the tunnel. 

So this monk asked me to write down 100 things from my whole life. People, I know my life is GREAT, but too often between my ears just sucks and I didn’t sign up for this shit!

I was literally stuck at 1 and he asked me, “You like your watch?” Ummm “yeah, I can use things like that?” “Yes,” he said, “It can be anything. What about GOD? You say you’re a big GOD guy? That’s 2. How about your son? You love your son? That’s 3.”

He asked me to think of things my whole life and we’ve all had some good moments. I started slow but eventually I got to 100. 

In the weeks that followed… I read that list every single day. Now, it’s how I start every morning.I do a list of 10 things I’m grateful for from the previous day or coming up today. And you can have some of the same things each day. It’s not restricted… It’s YOUR list. 

So I now wake up in gratitude instead of anxiety or dread. WAYYY better way to start my day. 

Let’s keep fighting this fight together!!!
#TeamUnbreakable #mentalhealth #mentalwealth
